description: This file defines a PHP class for managing shipping extensions within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling shipping extensions, and handles related configurations and permissions.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: This class manages the lifecycle of shipping extensions in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, installing, and uninstalling shipping modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language files, scans for extension controllers, verifies installation status, and prepares data for rendering the shipping extensions list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a new shipping extension, loads necessary permissions, and registers the extension's controllers, models, and views.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls an existing shipping extension, removes permissions, and performs cleanup.
